mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (product_id, total_quantity, available_quantity, reserved_quantity, sold_quantity, version) VALUES (#{productId}, #{totalQuantity}, #{totalQuantity}, 0, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, total_quantity, available_quantity, reserved_quantity, sold_quantity, version, updated_at FROM inventory WHERE product_id IN #{productId} ORDER BY product_id
SELECT product_id, total_quantity, available_quantity, reserved_quantity, sold_quantity, version, updated_at FROM inventory ORDER BY product_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_reservation (reservation_id, order_id, user_id, product_id, quantity, status, expires_at) VALUES (UUID(), #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, user_id, product_id, quantity, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM inventory_reservation WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY product_id LIMIT 1
SELECT order_id, user_id, product_id, quantity, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM inventory_reservation WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY product_id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO inventory_redis_sync (order_id, product_id, operation) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{operation})
mapper.select: SELECT sync_id, order_id, product_id, operation FROM inventory_redis_sync WHERE applied_at IS NULL ORDER BY sync_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_redis_sync SET applied_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), last_error = NULL WHERE sync_id = #{syncId} AND applied_at IS NULL
